note: Language -> {build, launch, status, mldsa} table for the N-AALP conformance adapters. 'wired' adapters build and pass the corpus in CI now; 'planned' adapters + their SDKs are built and graded under task #20. 'mldsa' records the deterministic FIPS 204 (rnd=0) library the SDK uses, or 'to-verify' until researched this session (C4/E8). An SDK with no deterministic ML-DSA returns skipped for mldsa.keygen/cose.sign1/cose.verify1 and is graded on every pure op; the gap is tracked here, never green-washed.

runner.build: cd harness/runner && GOWORK=off go build -o naalp-conform ./

go.build: cd harness/adapters/go && GOWORK=off go build -o naalp-adapter-go ./

python.mldsa: dilithium-py 1.4.0 (ML_DSA_65/87 sign(..., deterministic=True) -> FIPS 204 rnd=0); verified byte-identical to Go(CIRCL)+Rust(fips204)

typescript.build: cd impl/typescript && npm install; cd harness/adapters/typescript && npm install
typescript.mldsa: @noble/post-quantum 0.6.1 (ml_dsa65/87 sign(msg,sk,{extraEntropy:false}) = FIPS 204 rnd=0); verified byte-identical to go/rust/python/java/ruby

csharp.graded: ci-only (no working .NET SDK on the dev box; authored + statically self-reviewed against the Python reference; graded in CI via setup-dotnet)
csharp.mldsa: BouncyCastle.Cryptography 2.6.2 (MLDsaSigner deterministic:true = rnd=0; MLDsaPrivateKeyParameters.FromSeed matches NIST ACVP). full-crypto (graded in CI)

java.build: curl -L -o harness/adapters/java/lib/bcprov-jdk18on-1.85.jar https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/bouncycastle/bcprov-jdk18on/1.85/bcprov-jdk18on-1.85.jar && javac -cp harness/adapters/java/lib/bcprov-jdk18on-1.85.jar -d harness/adapters/java/out impl/java/src/sh/bubblefish/naalp/*.java harness/adapters/java/Json.java harness/adapters/java/Adapter.java
java.mldsa: BouncyCastle bcprov-jdk18on 1.85 (MLDSASigner init without ParametersWithRandom = FIPS 204 rnd=0; seed-only MLDSAPrivateKeyParameters keygen matches NIST ACVP); verified byte-identical

kotlin.mldsa: BouncyCastle bcprov-jdk18on 1.85 (JVM, same deterministic path as Java); verified byte-identical 239/239

php.mldsa: pure-only — no deterministic ML-DSA in PHP (liboqs/OpenSSL 3.5 are randomized-only). Grades all pure ops + Ed25519 (ext-sodium); skip-tracks mldsa.keygen/cose.sign1/cose.verify1 (235/239 graded, 4 honest skips)

ruby.mldsa: platform OpenSSL >= 3.5 (key.sign deterministic=1 = FIPS 204 rnd=0; seed->pk via PKCS#8); verified byte-identical on OpenSSL 3.6. Gracefully skips ML-DSA where OpenSSL < 3.5 (e.g. older CI runners)

swift.graded: 235 graded, 4 ML-DSA skip-tracked (built + graded on Swift 6.3.3 / Ubuntu 24.04 via WSL2; also graded in CI in a Swift container)
swift.mldsa: pure-only — SwiftDilithium 3.6.0 has NO seed-based keygen (only random), so the corpus seed->pk / deterministic-sign path cannot be produced; grades all pure ops + Ed25519 (swift-crypto), skip-tracks the ML-DSA leg. Upgradable if a Swift ML-DSA lib adds seed keygen.
